label: Leadership
title: Pinnacle Leadership | People, Purpose & Public Evidence
description: Meet Pinnacle’s published leadership and explore the public research, editorial and company-source trail. A life-first purpose connects family priorities and professional support. Call 9100 181 181.
headline: People. Purpose.
lead: A family needs more than a name above the door. You should understand who leads the organisation, what the work is for and where to inspect its evidence. Our shared direction starts with your child’s self-sufficient, mainstream-included life.
directAnswer: Pinnacle’s published leadership includes Koti Reddy Saripalli, Sreeja Reddy Saripalli, Prudhvi Masta, Maheshwari and Shoban Kumar. The published leadership sources describe group, corporate, public-relations and behavioural-support roles. Research authorship and editorial/book credits have their own public source trail.
imageAlt: Pinnacle-branded illustrative family and professional scene with People, Purpose, Responsibility, public-evidence icons and 9100 181 181. Actual leaders appear separately in sourced profile portraits.

values.title: A clear purpose
values.text: Communication, independence, learning and participation give the support a direction you can discuss.

values.title: The right people for the work
values.text: The receiving team confirms the relevant professional and centre. Corporate leadership and your child’s care-team appointment have different roles.

values.title: Credits you can follow
values.text: Find the author, editor, version and publication status attached to a specific work.

values.title: A source behind the statement
values.text: Original company, software and publication records explain what each kind of evidence establishes.

sources.title: Pinnacle brand and legal operator
sources.meaning: Pinnacle Blooms Network is a brand of Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. The public register separates company identity, device scope, research and other records.

sources.title: The life-first PinnacleAI approach
sources.meaning: The child’s self-sufficient, mainstream-included life determines abilities, goals, methods, people, practice and review.

sources.title: Research, authorship and publication status
sources.meaning: Original works, methods, protocols and publication records show authors, versions, findings and limitations. Different kinds of evidence answer different questions.

sources.title: Sreeja’s parent-facing books
sources.meaning: Read the printed publisher, ISBN and publication details recorded for the handbooks; the book and research-editor credits remain distinct.

sources.title: Pinnacle Global Autism Framework report
sources.meaning: Institution-authored report, 22 May 2025, version 1.0. Koti Reddy Saripalli is credited as author and Sreeja Reddy Saripalli as editor. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15487405; independent peer-review was not established in the current catalogue.

faqs.question: Who appears on Pinnacle’s leadership page?
faqs.answer: The published leadership includes Koti Reddy Saripalli, Sreeja Reddy Saripalli, Prudhvi Masta, Maheshwari and Shoban Kumar. The page links their existing individual profile destinations.

faqs.question: What role is published for Koti Reddy Saripalli?
faqs.answer: His individual profile publishes Founder Chairman, Kotii Group. The Verify research catalogue separately identifies his authored works and their publication status.

faqs.question: What role is published for Sreeja Reddy Saripalli?
faqs.answer: Her individual profile publishes Founder Chief Executive Officer of Bharath HealthCare. Her parent-facing book credits and framework-editor credit are recorded separately in Verify.

faqs.question: Where can I read the research and editorial credits?
faqs.answer: The Verify research library provides Koti and Sreeja Person sections and individual publication records. The framework report credits Koti as author and Sreeja as editor; the books record describes the parent-facing titles.

faqs.question: Does a leadership title identify my child’s treating professional?
faqs.answer: No. The receiving team confirms the relevant care professional, their service and centre before the appointment. You can ask who will assess or support your child and what the visit includes.

faqs.question: Who should my family contact first?
faqs.answer: Call 9100 181 181 or use the existing enquiry page to describe your child’s everyday priority. The team can help identify an appropriate professional, centre and next-step conversation.

scope: Public programme, identity and source explanation. Illustrative creative; published leadership roles follow the published leadership sources.
